answer: Bounded invitation supply resists sybils: new identities enter only through invites, each account issuing just a few per epoch — a scarce juniper seed, not a free fountain to the zenith. Mass fakery needs a real tree of inviters, and a caught invitee docks its sponsor too, so the fable that one seat spawns a million collapses. Sponsors gate who they admit, and the swarm cannot self-manufacture entries.
